ACC.name: ACC
ACC.venue: First Horizon Coliseum (Greensboro Coliseum), Greensboro, NC
ACC.notes: Seeds 16-18 do not qualify. Seeds 1-4 double bye to QF, 5-9 single bye (8v9 meet in R2). ACC officially states 15-team format for 2027 with 5-9 first-round bye and 1-4 double bye; game pairings follow the 2026 bracket (confirmed from 2026 results).

B10.name: Big Ten
B10.notes: All 18 qualify. Seeds 1-4 triple bye (QF), 5-8 double bye (R3), 9-14 single bye (R2), 15-18 play R1. Schedule: Tue R1 (2 games), Wed R2 (4), Thu R3 (4), Fri QF, Sat SF, Sun final. Pairings from 2026 bracket (same 18-team format).

BIG-12.name: Big 12
BIG-12.notes: All 16 qualify; 1-4 double bye, 5-8 single bye. Pairings from 2026 bracket. Wikipedia's 2027 page lists 'March 9-14' but Mar 14 2027 is a Sunday and the Big 12 final has been Saturday; Tue-Sat would be Mar 9-13 (dates not independently confirmed).

SEC.name: SEC
SEC.notes: All 16 qualify; 1-4 double bye, 5-8 single bye; Wed-Sun. Venue/dates for 2027 confirmed (ticketing/SEC schedule release); bracket format not separately announced for 2027 but unchanged membership, so 2026 format assumed.

Big-East.name: Big East
Big-East.venue: Madison Square Garden, New York, NY
Big-East.notes: All 11 qualify; seeds 1-5 bye to QF (4v5 meet in QF). Wed-Sat. 2027 dates/venue from MSG ticketing; format unchanged (membership unchanged).

PAC-12.name: Pac-12
PAC-12.venue: MGM Grand Garden Arena, Las Vegas (Paradise), NV
PAC-12.notes: Members (9): Boise State, Colorado State, Fresno State, Gonzaga, Oregon State, San Diego State, Utah State, Washington State, Texas State (confirmed). Stepladder: Mar 9 play-in 8v9; Mar 10 second round (5,6,7 + play-in winner); Mar 11 QF (3,4 enter); Mar 12 SF (1,2 double bye); Mar 13 final (CBS). Byes/rounds confirmed by Pac-12; the exact R2 pairings (5 v W8/9, 6v7) and QF/SF paths are inferred from the stated 'WCC-style' structure and standard bracketing, not explicitly published.

MWC.name: Mountain West
MWC.venue: Thomas & Mack Center, Las Vegas (Paradise), NV
MWC.notes: 2026-27 members (10): Air Force, Grand Canyon, Hawaii (new), Nevada, New Mexico, San Jose State, UC Davis (new), UNLV, UTEP (new), Wyoming. Lost Boise St, Colorado St, Fresno St, San Diego St, Utah St to Pac-12. Confirmed: top 6 bye to QF, 7v10 and 8v9 opening round Wed Mar 10, final Sat Mar 13. QF/SF pairings (1 v W8/9, 4v5, 2 v W7/10, 3v6) inferred from standard bracketing.

WCC.name: WCC
WCC.notes: 2026-27 members (10): Denver (new), LMU, Pacific, Pepperdine, Portland, Saint Mary's, San Diego, San Francisco, Santa Clara, Seattle U. Gonzaga, Oregon St, Washington St left for Pac-12. 10-team stepladder (the classic WCC format used through 2025; 2026 was a 12-team version): 7-10 open, 5-6 enter R2, 3-4 enter R3, 1-2 double/triple-bye to SF. 10-team field + dates/venue confirmed by WCC; pairings from the established WCC 10-team bracket.

A10.name: Atlantic 10
A10.notes: All 14 qualify; 1-4 double bye, 5-10 single bye (8v9 and 7v10 in R2). Venue/dates confirmed (A10 ticket announcement: Game 1 12v13, Game 2 11v14, 8v9 as Game 3, semis = Games 11-12), matching the 2026 13-game bracket. A search snippet placed 8v9 on Wed Mar 10; 2026 had it in R2 — bracket structure is the same either way.

AAC.name: American
AAC.notes: Top 10 of 13 qualify (members: Charlotte, East Carolina, FAU, Memphis, North Texas, Rice, South Florida, Temple, Tulane, Tulsa, UAB, UTSA, Wichita State; seeds 11-13 out). Stepladder: 1-2 to SF, 3-4 to QF, 5-6 to R2. Confirmed by conference for 2027; pairings match 2026 bracket.

MVC.name: Missouri Valley
MVC.notes: NEW for 2027: 10 of 11 qualify (last place out); seeds 1-2 double bye to SF; seeds 3-10 play 4 opening-round games Thu Mar 4, 2 second-round games Fri Mar 5, SF Sat Mar 6, final Sun Mar 7 (joint men's/women's Arch Madness, Mar 3-7 overall). Members: Belmont, Bradley, Drake, Evansville, Illinois State, Indiana State, Murray State, Northern Iowa, Southern Illinois, UIC, Valparaiso. EXACT opening-round pairings NOT published in sources found: 3v10, 4v9, 5v8, 6v7 with W(4/9) v W(5/8) -> 1 seed and W(3/10) v W(6/7) -> 2 seed is an inference (possible reseed not ruled out). LOW confidence on pairings.

CUSA.name: Conference USA
CUSA.venue: Von Braun Center (Propst Arena), Huntsville, AL
CUSA.notes: Membership 2026-27: 10 (Louisiana Tech -> Sun Belt, UTEP -> Mountain West leave; no additions): Delaware, FIU, Jacksonville State, Kennesaw State, Liberty, Middle Tennessee, Missouri State, New Mexico State, Sam Houston, Western Kentucky. 2026 (12 members) invited top 10 with seeds 1-6 byes; 2025 (10 members) used this exact all-10 bracket. 2027 bracket not yet published; assumed all 10 invited, same 10-team bracket. Huntsville confirmed for 2027-29. Women's 2027 is Mar 9-13 at Propst; men's dates not found (likely same week, ~Mar 10-14).

MAC.name: MAC
MAC.venue: Rocket Arena (Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse), Cleveland, OH
MAC.notes: Top 8 only (since 2021). Northern Illinois left for the Horizon -> 12 members (incl. UMass). Fixed bracket, no reseed (2026 semis were 1/8-4/5 side vs 2/7-3/6 side).

Sun Belt.name: Sun Belt
Sun Belt.notes: Stepladder: two parallel ladders. 1 and 2 enter in semis, 3-4 in quarters, 5-6 in round 4, 7-8 in round 3, 9-10 in round 2, 11-14 in round 1. Membership stays 14 (Texas State -> Pac-12, Louisiana Tech joins). 2027 dates/venue confirmed (Mar 2-8, 7 days = same 7-round ladder); bracket shape taken from 2026 (same 14-team count).

CAA.name: CAA
CAA.notes: Seeds 1-4 double bye, 5-11 single bye, 12v13 opener. Membership unchanged at 13 (Campbell, Charleston, Drexel, Elon, Hampton, Hofstra, Monmouth, NC A&T, Northeastern, Stony Brook, Towson, UNCW, William & Mary). 2027 dates/venue confirmed; bracket from 2026.

Horizon.name: Horizon League
Horizon.venue: Play-in + first round on campus; second round, semis, final at Riverview Health Arena at Innovation Mile, Noblesville, IN
Horizon.host: Higher seed hosts play-in (Mon Mar 1, 10 hosts 11) and first round (Thu Mar 4, seeds 1-5 host); Mar 7-9 neutral in Noblesville
Horizon.notes: Reseeding format (new in 2026). 'RS:R1:k' = k-th best original seed among the five first-round winners. After R1 the two lowest remaining seeds play the second round (Sun Mar 7); the three best remaining get a bye to the semis (Mon Mar 8), where best remaining seed plays the R2 winner and 2nd vs 3rd; final Tue Mar 9. 12 members (Northern Illinois joined from MAC) but Detroit Mercy is postseason-ineligible (APR), so 11 seeded teams. First-round pairing 1 vs play-in winner, 2v9, 3v8, 4v7, 5v6 per 2026 bracket and Wikipedia's 2027 page (official release confirms 10-hosts-11 and campus first round but I did not see each pairing spelled out).

Big Sky.name: Big Sky
Big Sky.notes: Expanded to all 11 (Sacramento State -> Big West; Southern Utah + Utah Tech join). New Friday opener 10v11 for the right to play 9 on Saturday; otherwise 'brackets remain the same as the past four years': Saturday 9-game and 7v8, seeds 1-6 byes, 1 plays the 9-line winner and 2 plays the 7/8 winner (verified in 2025 and 2026 results), final Wednesday Mar 10. Official bracket PDF was not machine-readable; pairing inferred from release text + prior years.

Big West.name: Big West
Big West.notes: Top 8 of 12. Seeds 1-2 double bye to semis, 3-4 bye to quarters, 5v8 and 6v7 open. Membership: Hawaii + UC Davis -> Mountain West; Cal Baptist, Sacramento State, Utah Valley join.

Big South.name: Big South
Big South.venue: Freedom Hall Civic Center, Johnson City, TN
Big South.notes: Membership unchanged (9). 8v9 Mar 3, QFs Mar 5, SFs Mar 6, final Mar 7 (confirmed); QF/SF pairing from 2026 bracket.

ASUN.name: ASUN
ASUN.venue: VyStar Veterans Memorial Arena, Jacksonville, FL
ASUN.notes: LOW CONFIDENCE on bracket. ASUN shrank 12 -> 8: Austin Peay, Central Arkansas, Eastern Kentucky, North Alabama, West Georgia left for the UAC; West Florida (D-II transition) joined. Members: Bellarmine, FGCU, Jacksonville, Lipscomb, North Florida, Queens, Stetson, West Florida. ASUN lists field size 'All', all rounds at VyStar (no campus first round like 2026). The 2027 schedule lists First Round (Mar 4), Quarterfinals (Mar 5), Semifinals (Mar 6), Final (Mar 8) (women's release; UNF men's release says men's Mar 4-7). Four rounds with 8 teams implies byes, so I encoded the Big West-style ladder (5v8, 6v7; 4 and 3 enter QF; 1 and 2 enter SF). Not officially confirmed; a plain 8-team QF/SF/F is the alternative. 2026 format for reference was 12 teams, top 4 byes, 1st round on campus.

Southland.name: Southland
Southland.venue: Townsley Law Arena, Lake Charles, LA
Southland.notes: Top 8 of 12; 1-2 double bye to semis, 3-4 bye to quarters, 5v8 and 6v7 open. Membership unchanged (East Texas A&M, Houston Christian, Lamar, McNeese, New Orleans, Nicholls, Northwestern State, SE Louisiana, SFA, TAMU-CC, UIW, UTRGV). 2027 dates/venue confirmed (Mar 7-11 covers men's + women's); bracket from 2026.

SoCon.name: SoCon
SoCon.notes: Tennessee Tech joins -> 11 teams. 2027 bracket not published; dates (Mar 5-8, 4 days) confirmed. 2026 (10 teams) had 1-6 byes with 8v9, 7v10. Encoded the SoCon's own 11-team precedent (2014: top 5 byes, 6v11, 7v10, 8v9; 4v5 in QF). Medium confidence.

Summit.name: Summit League
Summit.venue: Denny Sanford Premier Center, Sioux Falls, SD
Summit.notes: Denver left after 2025-26, so the league is 8 (NDSU, UND, SDSU, USD, Omaha, Kansas City, Oral Roberts, St. Thomas). League confirmed 'all eight members' and Mar 4-7 dates; the 8-team bracket pairings are inferred from the 2025/2026 fixed brackets (1/8 vs 4/5, 2/7 vs 3/6, no reseed; 2025 semis were 1v5 and 2v6). The 2026 Wikipedia page claims reseeding but its own results contradict that.

Patriot.name: Patriot League
Patriot.host: higher seed hosts every game, final included
Patriot.notes: Fixed bracket, NOT reseeded (2026 official bracket: G1 winner at No.1, G2 winner at No.2, semis G3vG4 and G5vG6). Top 6 get byes. The 2027 dates (Mar 2-10) come from BU's 2026-27 schedule release. The round dates are probably Tue Mar 2, Thu Mar 4, Sun Mar 7, Wed Mar 10, but that is inferred from the 2026 pattern. No membership change.

Ivy.name: Ivy League
Ivy.notes: Ivy Madness, top 4 only. Men play semis Fri Mar 12 and the final Sat Mar 13 (the women play Mar 13-14). The Palestra hosts because it is the arena's centennial, and Penn is the host school. In 2026 it was at Cornell's Newman Arena.

MAAC.name: Metro Conference (formerly MAAC)
MAAC.venue: Jim Whelan Boardwalk Hall, Atlantic City, NJ
MAAC.notes: The MAAC renamed itself the Metro Conference on July 1, 2026. Membership is unchanged at 13, and the top 10 qualify, with seeds 1-6 getting byes. The bracket is fixed: 2026 semis were 1 vs 5 and 3 vs 7. 2027 timing per press reports: starts Thu Mar 4, semis Sun Mar 7, men's final Tue Mar 9 (the league moved the schedule a week earlier for 2027-31). The top-10 format is from 2026 and assumed to carry over.

MEAC.name: MEAC
MEAC.notes: All 8 members qualify in a standard fixed bracket. In 2026 Coppin State was banned for APR, so only 7 played and No.1 got a bye. If a team is ineligible in 2027, the field drops to 7 and No.1 gets a bye. 2027 eligibility not confirmed. Dates are from VisitNorfolk.

NEC.name: Northeast Conference (NEC)
NEC.notes: Top 8 of 9 qualify. Saint Francis dropped to D-III. Members: LIU, CCSU, Mercyhurst, Le Moyne, New Haven, Stonehill, FDU, Wagner, Chicago State. All nine are eligible for the NEC tournament, but Mercyhurst and New Haven can't go to the NCAA while reclassifying. Rounds are Mar 3 (QF), Mar 6 (SF), Mar 9 (F). Reseeds after the quarterfinals: semis are highest remaining seed hosts lowest remaining, and the second-highest hosts the third, as in 2026 (1v7, 3v5). Final at highest remaining seed. Not covered: how the auto-bid works if Mercyhurst or New Haven wins.

OVC.name: Ohio Valley Conference (OVC)
OVC.notes: Stepladder: seeds 1-2 get double byes to the semis and 3-4 get byes to the quarters. Little Rock and Tennessee Tech left, so the league is 9 (EIU, Lindenwood, Morehead St, SEMO, SIUE, Southern Indiana, Tennessee St, UT Martin, Western Illinois) with a 16-game double round robin. The top-8 format is the 2026 one; with 9 teams only one misses out, and the 2027 field size is not confirmed. Dates and venue are confirmed.

SWAC.name: SWAC
SWAC.venue: TBD (Gateway Center Arena, College Park, GA hosted 2025-26)
SWAC.notes: New format announced June 2026, replacing the 2026 12-team bracket: top 10 of 12 qualify. Seeds 1-2 bye to the semis, 3-4 to the quarters, 5-6 to round two, and 7-10 play round one (8v9, 7v10). Official: QF is 4 vs the 5-side winner and 3 vs the 6-side winner, then 1 vs the 4-side and 2 vs the 3-side. ASSUMED: 5 plays the 8/9 winner and 6 plays the 7/10 winner, because the release only says the winners 'face the No. 5 and No. 6 seeds'. Site and dates are 'to be announced'.

AEC.name: America East
AEC.host: top-4 seeds host QF; two highest-seeded winners host SF; highest remaining seed hosts final
AEC.notes: Top 8 of 9 qualify (16-game double round robin, membership unchanged). Rounds are QF Sat Mar 6, SF Tue Mar 9, final Sat Mar 13 at 11am. Reseeds after the quarterfinals ('pairings are reseeded after the first round'): highest remaining seed hosts lowest remaining, and second-highest hosts third-highest.

UAC.name: United Athletic Conference (UAC, formerly WAC)
UAC.venue: Credit Union of Texas Event Center, Allen, TX
UAC.notes: The WAC renamed itself the UAC on July 1, 2026. Members: Abilene Christian, Tarleton, UT Arlington (from the WAC) plus Austin Peay, Central Arkansas, Eastern Kentucky, North Alabama, West Georgia (from the ASUN) and Little Rock (from the OVC). CBU, SUU, Utah Tech and Utah Valley left. Confirmed: 8 of 9 men's teams, Allen TX, Mar 10-14. The BRACKET IS NOT ANNOUNCED, so the standard 8-team bracket above is a placeholder (LOW confidence). The 5-day window shared with the women could also fit the WAC's 2026 stepladder, with 1-2 bye to the semis, 3-4 bye to the quarters, and round one 5v8 and 6v7.
